description: Source code for handling recap-related API endpoints in Mattermost, including creating, retrieving, updating, regenerating, and deleting recaps, with audit logging and permission checks.

classes.name: API
classes.description: API class with method InitRecap to initialize recap routes.

methods.name: InitRecap
methods.description: Initializes API routes for recap operations, binding HTTP methods and paths to handler functions.

methods.name: requireRecapsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if AI recaps feature is enabled; sets error if disabled.

methods.name: addRecapChannelIDsToAuditRec
methods.description: Extracts channel IDs from a recap and adds them to an audit record.

methods.name: createRecap
methods.description: Handles creation of a new recap, including validation, permission checks, and audit logging.

methods.name: getRecap
methods.description: Retrieves a specific recap, with permission validation and audit logging.

methods.name: getRecaps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recaps for the user, with audit logging.

methods.name: markRecapAsRead
methods.description: Marks a specific recap as read, with permission validation and audit logging.

methods.name: regenerateRecap
methods.description: Regenerates a recap, with permission validation and audit logging.

methods.name: deleteRecap
